welcomeEnabled.title: Welcome new viewers
welcomeEnabled.description: Show the existing Afterdark Brotherhood welcome notice when someone enters.

tipAcknowledgmentEnabled.title: Tip acknowledgment notices
tipAcknowledgmentEnabled.description: Enable or silence the automatic thank-you notice after tips. Tip tracking and VIP attribution continue either way.

loyaltyEnabled.title: Enable loyalty points
loyaltyEnabled.description: Master switch for daily visit, verified viewing, and meaningful-chat points. Existing balances and reward requests are preserved.

dailyVisitPoints.title: Daily visit points
dailyVisitPoints.description: Points awarded once per viewer per UTC day. Set to 0 to disable this earning source.

watchPointsPerFiveMinutes.title: Viewing points per 5 minutes
watchPointsPerFiveMinutes.description: Points for each complete five-minute room-viewing interval. Set to 0 to disable viewing rewards.

meaningfulChatPoints.title: Meaningful chat points
meaningfulChatPoints.description: Points for a qualifying message after its cooldown. Set to 0 to disable this earning source.

settingsHelp.title: Configuration guide
settingsHelp.description: These are native Chaturbate App V2 settings. Changes apply automatically; persistent viewer balances and room activity are not reset.
